name: @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/render-web
description: Same-origin Render web server for Agentic hosted BYOK planning.

scripts.build: pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/workflow build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/a2a-agent-card build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/ap2-adapter build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/acp-adapter build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/bridge-router build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/streaming-sessions build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/signals-runtime build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/skills-runtime build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/launch-skills build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/mcp-server build && node ../../scripts/run-with-logs.mjs --label render-web-tsc -- tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/workflow build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/a2a-agent-card build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/ap2-adapter build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/acp-adapter build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/bridge-router build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/streaming-sessions build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/signals-runtime build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/skills-runtime build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/launch-skills build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/mcp-server build && node ../../scripts/run-with-logs.mjs --label render-web-typecheck -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/workflow build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/a2a-agent-card build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/ap2-adapter build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/acp-adapter build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/bridge-router build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/streaming-sessions build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/signals-runtime build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/skills-runtime build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/launch-skills build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/mcp-server build && vitest run
